---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — imputation"
subtitle: "Five completed datasets for the supporting PH and non-PH models"
format: html
---

- Death indicator and Nelson–Aalen use unrestricted follow-up, not the 182-day endpoint.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(mice)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

# The passive mice methods call derive_ecog_binary() and derive_mgps(), so
# they must be visible in the global environment.
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "04-unrestricted-follow-up", "results"
)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

imputation_path <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations.rds")
```

## Imputation data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-imputation-data
#| include: false

imputation_data <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  # Column order sets the MICE visit sequence.
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    status_death_unrestricted,
    ecog_fstcnt,
    stage_binary,
    lung,
    age,
    gender,
    albumin,
    bilirubin,
    c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
    mgps = derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein),
    ecog_fstcnt = ordered(ecog_fstcnt, levels = 0:4),
    gender = factor(gender),
    na_est = nelsonaalen(
      pick(everything()),
      timevar = survival_time_days_unrestricted,
      statusvar = status_death_unrestricted
    )
  ) |>
  # Passive variables last, so they update after their sources.
  relocate(ecog_binary, mgps, .after = last_col())
```

## Imputation model

```{r}
#| label: impute
#| include: false

fixed_columns <- c(
  "id",
  "tx",
  "survival_time_days_unrestricted",
  "status_death_unrestricted",
  "na_est"
)

methods <- make.method(imputation_data)
methods[fixed_columns] <- ""
methods["ecog_fstcnt"] <- "polr"
methods["ecog_binary"] <- "~I(derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt))"
methods["mgps"] <- "~I(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein))"

predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(imputation_data)
predictors[fixed_columns, ] <- 0
predictors[, c(
  "id",
  "survival_time_days_unrestricted",
  "ecog_binary",
  "mgps"
)] <- 0

if (!file.exists(imputation_path)) {
  imputation <- mice(
    imputation_data,
    method = methods,
    predictorMatrix = predictors,
    m = config$imputation$m_supporting,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 600,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(imputation, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
}

imputation <- readRDS(imputation_path)
```

## Convergence and imputed distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-supporting-os-unrestricted-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE trace plots for directly imputed variables in the unrestricted-follow-up OS analyses: mean and standard deviation of the imputed values, one line per completed dataset"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
#| echo: false

plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(imputation))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supporting-os-unrestricted-imputation-distributions
#| fig-cap: "Observed (black) and imputed (pink, one line per completed dataset) distributions of the laboratory variables in the unrestricted-follow-up OS analyses"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false

lab_values <- imputed_values(
  imputation,
  c(
    Albumin = "albumin",
    Bilirubin = "bilirubin",
    CRP = "c_reactive_protein",
    LDH = "lactate_dehydrogenase"
  )
)

plot_imputed_densities(lab_values$observed, lab_values$imputed)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-supporting-os-unrestricted-imputation-categories
#| fig-cap: "Category proportions of the ordered ECOG score and the derived mGPS among observed values (black) and imputed values of each completed dataset (pink) in the unrestricted-follow-up OS analyses"

imputation |>
```
